## 🛡️ INVEST Quality Checklist
<!-- Self-audit this story against Agile quality standards before saving the issue. -->
- [ ] **Independent**: This story can be developed and released on its own without strict dependencies.
- [ ] **Negotiable**: The story allows for conversation and adjustment between stakeholders and engineering.
- [ ] **Valuable**: This change delivers clear, vertical business or end-user value.
- [ ] **Estimable**: The scope is clear enough for the development team to assign story points.
- [ ] **Small**: The work can be fully completed within a single sprint block.
- [ ] **Testable**: The acceptance criteria provide explicit pass/fail conditions for QA.
